user.title: Set up bathroom
user.description: Pick the sensors of your bathroom. Only the presence sensor is required, every other sensor makes detection more accurate.

data_description.presence_sensor: mmWave/PIR sensor detecting people in the room.
data_description.entry_sensor: Motion sensor at the entrance. Starts the entry window. Without it the door contact takes over.
data_description.door_sensor: Used for quick release when leaving.
data_description.toilet_lid_sensor: An open lid means definite use and keeps the room occupied.
data_description.humidity_sensor: The shower is detected from rising humidity.

init.title: Bathroom settings
init.description: What do you want to change?

timings.title: Timings and thresholds
timings.description: Settings are grouped by feature. Groups for sensors you have not set up are hidden.

release.name: Entry and release
release.description: When the bathroom counts as occupied and when it becomes free again.

data_description.entry_window: After an entry the presence sensor must detect someone within this time to mark the room occupied.
data_description.release_delay: The room must be without presence this long before it is released.

quick_exit.name: Quick release via door contact
quick_exit.description: Releases earlier when someone opens the door and leaves.

data_description.exit_wait_for_absence: After the door opens, wait this long for absence, then release immediately.
data_description.exit_reentry_guard: If presence returns within this time after leaving, the room stays occupied.

emergency.name: Emergency release
emergency.description: Releases when the room has been occupied unusually long and nobody is there anymore.

data_description.max_occupancy: After this time the emergency release kicks in.
data_description.max_occupancy_absence: The emergency release only releases after no presence for this long.

data.shower_on_duration: Shower on: rise for at least
data.shower_off_duration: Shower off: flat for at least

data_description.humidity_window: Time window used to compute the humidity rise.
data_description.shower_on_rate: A faster rise counts as showering. Lower value = more sensitive.
data_description.shower_on_duration: The rise must last this long before a shower is detected.
data_description.shower_off_rate: When the rise drops below this value, the shower starts to end.
data_description.shower_off_duration: Humidity must stay flat this long for the shower to end.
data_description.shower_max_duration: The shower ends at the latest after this time.

toilet.name: Toilet lid
toilet.description: Warning when the lid stays open too long.

data_description.toilet_lid_alert: After the lid is open this long the warning event fires.
